target.rawSql: SELECT start_time AS time, COALESCE(end_time, NOW()) AS timeend, event_name || ' (' || severity || ')' AS text FROM event_frames

panels.description: High-speed LTTB downsampled telemetry trend enriched with ISA-95 asset hierarchy via ClickHouse PostgreSQL dictionary.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pt.1 AS time, dictGet('pi_historian.pg_asset_tags', 'tag_name', toUInt64(tag_id)) AS metric, pt.2 AS value FROM (SELECT tag_id, arrayJoin(largestTriangleThreeBuckets(500)(ts, val)) AS pt FROM pi_historian.sensor_data WHERE quality >= 192 AND dictGet('pi_historian.pg_asset_tags', 'asset_path', toUInt64(tag_id)) = '${asset_path}' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY tag_id) ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Panel 1: High-Speed LTTB Downsampled Process Trend (${asset_path})

panels.description: 1-Minute real-time AggregatingMergeTree rollups (minMerge, avgMerge, maxMerge) filtered strictly on good OPC quality (>= 192).

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_1m AS time, dictGet('pi_historian.pg_asset_tags', 'tag_name', toUInt64(tag_id)) AS tag_name, round(minMerge(min_val), 3) AS min_val, round(avgMerge(avg_val), 3) AS avg_val, round(maxMerge(max_val), 3) AS max_val FROM pi_historian.sensor_rollup_1m WHERE dictGet('pi_historian.pg_asset_tags', 'asset_path', toUInt64(tag_id)) = '${asset_path}' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_1m) GROUP BY tag_id, bucket_1m ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Panel 2: 1-Minute Real-Time Rollup Band (minMerge / avgMerge / maxMerge)

panels.description: ISA-88 Batch & Excursion Event Frames with captured summary metrics and 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Signatures.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ef.event_name, ef.event_template, ef.severity, ef.start_time, ef.end_time, ef.captured_metrics::text AS captured_metrics, COALESCE(ef.signed_by, 'UNSIGNED') AS signed_by, COALESCE(ef.signature_meaning, '-') AS signature_meaning, ef.signed_at, left(COALESCE(ef.signature_hash, ''), 16) AS signature_hash_prefix FROM event_frames ef JOIN assets a ON ef.asset_id = a.asset_id WHERE a.asset_path::text = '${asset_path}' ORDER BY ef.start_time DESC;

panels.title: Panel 3: Active & Signed Event Frames Table (21 CFR Part 11 §11.50)

panels.description: Immutable WORM 21 CFR Part 11 Audit Trail with SHA-256 cryptographic hash chaining.

targets.rawSql: SELECT audit_id, recorded_at, actor_id, change_reason, target_table, record_pk, operation, left(prev_hash, 16) AS prev_hash_prefix, left(row_hash, 16) AS row_hash_prefix FROM part11_audit_log ORDER BY audit_id DESC LIMIT 100;

panels.title: Panel 4: Live 21 CFR Part 11 Audit Log Inspector (WORM Hash Chain)
